                }
                desc = oe_wp33.201.d_subject
            }

    }

        10 = exterior
        10 = regular
    }

    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
    }

    immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = {
            foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate
            background = estate_type:crown_estate
        }
    }

    # Option A: Uphold Viceroyalty Charter Compromise (Subject Loyalty & Range vs -2% Tax)
    option = {
        name = oe_wp33.201.a
        ai_chance = { base = 45 }
        oe_wp33_clear_compass_colonial_mods = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_charter
            years = 3
            mode = replace
        }
    }

    # Option B: Tighten Crown Mercantile Tariffs (Subject Income & Trade Protection vs Loyalty)
    option = {
        name = oe_wp33.201.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        oe_wp33_clear_compass_colonial_mods = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_mercantile
            years = 3
            mode = replace
        }
    }

    # Option C: File Colonial Dossier Only (Retain 1-Year Audit Without Further Decree)
    option = {
        name = oe_wp33.201.c
        ai_chance = { base = 25 }
        add_prestige = 1
    }
